title: First Signal for Ilse
text:
Up on the roof, the neon hums below,
Vega turns the dial and the city answers slow.
I carry her the voices from the swap-hour air,
a baker's laugh, a tram bell, someone calling 'where?'
We lay them down like beads on a string,
and Ilse's words go in between each thing.
It's clumsy, I know, the rhythm drags a bit,
but Vega's light comes on, so I'll keep it.
